snippet.title: Last Salaryman: Survival Idle RPG | Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Last Salaryman: Survival Idle RPG is a zombie survival idle game that runs at the bottom of your desktop. Scavenge for gear, build your hideout, and experiment with weapons and skills while your survivor keeps fighting.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5412930/

Official website:
https://threefilmgames.com/

#LastSalaryman #IndieGame #IdleGame
